mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_vector( course_no, title, instructor_no, chunk_no, content, embedding ) VALUES( #{course_no}, #{title}, #{instructor_no}, #{chunk_no}, #{content}, #{embedding}::vector )

INSERT INTO question_vector( question_no, theme, type, difficulty, title, description, answer, option1, option2, option3, option4, content, embedding ) VALUES( #{question_no}, #{theme}, #{type}, #{difficulty}, #{title}, #{description}, #{answer}, #{option1}, #{option2}, #{option3}, #{option4}, #{content}, #{embedding}::vector )
